## 分诊 · `pm:blocked` / `domain:spec` / `priority:p2` / `enhancement`

⛔ 本席位只分诊：不认领、不派单、不写码、不合并、不裁决 decision-box 卡。方向已由维护者裁决 **B**（#14478 `5548763981`，batch #43）定下。

**Blocked-by:** objectstack-ai/objectstack#15676（栈 1/6）
**Restart-when:** 1/6 的 PR **存在**（分支已推、base 指向 #15626）—— ⛔ 不是「1/6 已合并」。整条栈**一起落地**（裁决：`the set lands together when check:duration-unit-keys is green on the stacked head`），所以本卡等的是**可叠加的 head**，不是一次合并。

### 为什么是 `pm:blocked` 而不是 `pm:queue`

1/6 逐字写着：「every directory card (2–5) applies the rule to what remains **after these two classes are declared**, so they wait for this one's PR to exist.」⇒ 在 `EpochMs` 与 `.meta({ externalVocabulary })` 两个豁免类被声明之前，本卡的人口（`api/` 的 12 个键）**尚未定型**——里面可能含有本该被豁免、而不该被改名的键。⛔ 提前开工会产生需要回退的重命名。

### ⭐ 人口切分已交叉验证（详见 #15676 上的分诊评论）

四张目录卡的键数相加 **12 + 14 + 13 + 7 = 46**，正是 1/6 声明的「本卡之后预期 offender 数 = 65 − 6 − 13 = 46」。⇒ 本卡的 **12** 与其余三张**无重叠、无缺口**。

⚠️ 佐证而已：裁决 (1) 明令 **门自己的谓词才是人口的定义**，⛔ 任何人不得用另一套规则重数。动手时以叠加 head 上 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:duration-unit-keys` 的输出为准。

### 为什么锚定 `domain:spec` / `priority:p2` / `enhancement`

落点 `packages/spec/src/api/**` 的 schema ⇒ `domain:spec`。整条栈同级 p2（它们是**一个落地单元**，分级会制造不存在的取舍）。重命名已发布键 ⇒ 改变可授权表面 ⇒ Feature 侧、manual floor；卡片自陈 `Clause-②: yes`，⛔ `needs:contract-review` 由 PR 创建时同笔贴到 PR 与卡上，本席位不代贴。

### ⚠️ 本卡特有的一条（`ApiError.retryAfter`）

标题点名它**自带 BREAKING 注记**。⇒ 这是 `api/` 这批里对外可见度最高的一个键，changeset 的 BREAKING banner 与 ADR-0087 conversion id ⛔ 不能漏。

### 通用四条（与整条栈一致）

1. ⛔ 绝不 `Fixes #14478`；PR 首行 `Part of #14478`，次行指名本卡且不带关闭关键字。
2. 分支叠在 1/6 的 head 上，PR base 指向它，**draft**。⛔ 不要对 `main` 开 PR。
3. ⚠️ **这道门今天不在 `main` 上**——本席位实测：全树无 `duration-unit-keys` 文件、`package.json` 无该脚本注册（阳性对照：`packages/spec/scripts` 下 125 个文件）。它只存在于 PR #15626 的草稿分支。⇒ ⛔ 不要在 `main` 上找它。
4. ⛔ 不要把 1/6 正文里的豁免表当既成事实：那 13 条「external standard」的归属是**读来的**，dev 需逐条对照 schema 自己的 docblock；核实下来不镜像任何标准的键，**属于本卡这类目录卡的一次重命名**，不是一个 marker。

## Dispatched — `pm:blocked` → `pm:dispatched`

Claim: session `session_01G4138K1EG7kQ81FNba5Kp4`, `domain:spec` seat, `2026-09-05T09:16Z`. Label swap done as one read-modify-write with a comparison read-back; nothing else on the card was stripped.

Card 1/6 has a PR to stack on — **#15814, head `c1949b9ac0286c211100d836ea6082e29542a3de`** — so this card's blocker is cleared. The stack is **serial (2 → 3 → 4 → 5 → 6)**, per this card's own execution note, so 3/6–5/6 stay `pm:blocked` until this one has a PR.

### ⭐ The twelfth row came back — `interval` is yours

This card said: *"if card 1/6's verification finds it is NOT a standard's name, it returns here as a rename."* It did, and it does.

Card 1/6's dev demoted `api/DeviceRequestResponse.interval` rather than marking it, on the schema's own evidence: `DeviceRequestResponseSchema` does not mirror RFC 8628 as a set — `code` is not `device_code`, `verificationUrl` is not `verification_uri`, `expiresAt` is not `expires_in` (different name *and* different type). A schema that already renames RFC fields to house style cannot claim "the standard fixes this name" for one of them.

So this card's population is **12 = your 11 + `interval`**, exactly the number in its title.

### The population, re-derived on the stacked head (⛔ do not use this card's `e68ae2b58` line numbers — several moved)

Measured `2026-09-05T09:1xZ` by an independent run of `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:duration-unit-keys` on `c1949b9ac`, exit 1, exit code captured before any pipe. All twelve are rule `unit-in-prose-not-in-name`:

| # | gate path:line | key | `<Schema>.<key>` |
| --: | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 1 | `src/api/auth-endpoints.zod.ts:287` | `interval` | `DeviceRequestResponse.interval` |
| 2 | `src/api/contract.zod.ts:403` | `cacheTtl` | `DataLoaderConfig.cacheTtl` |
| 3 | `src/api/endpoint.zod.ts:186` | `cacheTtl` | `ApiEndpoint.cacheTtl` |
| 4 | `src/api/errors.zod.ts:394` | `retryAfter` | `EnhancedApiError.retryAfter` |
| 5 | `src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:202` | `timeout` | `RestApiEndpoint.timeout` |
| 6 | `src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:205` | `cacheTtl` | `RestApiEndpoint.cacheTtl` |
| 7 | `src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:717` | `defaultCacheTtl` | `RestApiPluginConfig.defaultCacheTtl` |
| 8 | `src/api/router.zod.ts:98` | `timeout` | `RouteDefinition.timeout` |
| 9 | `src/api/websocket.zod.ts:423` | `reconnectInterval` | `WebSocketConfig.reconnectInterval` |
| 10 | `src/api/websocket.zod.ts:425` | `pingInterval` | `WebSocketConfig.pingInterval` |
| 11 | `src/api/websocket.zod.ts:426` | `timeout` | `WebSocketConfig.timeout` |
| 12 | `src/api/websocket.zod.ts:588` | `heartbeatInterval` | `WebSocketServerConfig.heartbeatInterval` |

The `<Schema>` column is derived by resolving the nearest preceding top-level `export const …Schema` — the gate prints only path:line and the key, so treat path:line as authoritative and the schema name as a convenience. ⛔ Re-run the gate yourself before editing and ⛔ never recount by another rule: ruling (1) makes the gate's own predicate the population's definition.

`api/` must read **0** when this card is done, and the whole-tree count must fall **48 → 36**. Anything else means the card moved something it did not own.

### What this card must not touch

⛔ `kernel/` (14, card 3/6) · `system/` (15, card 4/6 — retitled from 13 today) · `data/` `ui/` `ai/` `integration/` (7, card 5/6) · the gate's declared population (card 6/6) · `content/docs/releases/` · PR #15814's own diff.

### Two facts about CI you will otherwise discover the hard way

1. **Heavy CI does not run on a stacked PR.** `lint.yml` and `ci.yml` both declare `pull_request: branches: [main]`, so a PR based on a feature branch triggers **neither** — measured 0 runs against a control of 3 on a main-based branch. None of the 7 required contexts will report on your head. Your local measurements and your reverse-verification are the only evidence this card gets, so run them as if nothing downstream will catch a mistake, because nothing will until integration.
2. **A `skills/**` hit makes the PR governed — keep it.** Card 1/6 is governed on one generated line and that was accepted, not worked around. ⛔ Do not drop a file to escape governance; the whole stack is human-merged regardless.
